senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) [runner, wild; v. Del. Proleg. p. 94] mule.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 54a:7">Pes. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>אף האור והפ׳</he> also fire and the mule (were created on the sixth day at twilight).
<cite ref="Pesachim 54a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>הביא שתי … ויצא מהן פ׳</he> Adam took two (heterogeneous) animals … and from them came forth a mule.
Tosef. Kil. V, 5 לא יקשור סוס לפ׳ ופ׳ וכ׳ one must not tie a horse to a mule or a mule to an ass; a. e.—Fem. פִּרְדָּה, פִּי׳ (also for the male).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:5:7">Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵇ</cite> <he>ויצא מהן פ׳</he>, v. supra; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> end <he>ויצאת … פ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ לבנה</he> a white mule.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 5:6">Tosef. Kil. V, 6</cite> <he>אסור לרכוב ע״ג פי׳</he> it is forbidden to ride on the back of a mule.
<cite ref="Megillah 13b:18">Meg. 13ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>מפרד</he>, <cite ref="Esther 3:8">Esth. III, 8</cite>) <he>כפְּרִידָה וכ׳</he> (the Jews are) like the mule that is unproductive.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:6">Gen. R. s. 41</cite> (play on <he>הפרד</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 13:9">Gen. XIII, 9</cite>) <he>מה הפ׳ הזו אינה קולטת זרע וכ׳</he> as the mule does not breed the semen she receives, so it is impossible for this man (Lot) to mix with the seed of Abraham.
<cite ref="Genesis 13:9">Ib.</cite> <he>אברהם פ׳ עקרה</he>, v. <cite ref="P01216"><he>עָקָר</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>פִּרְדּוֹת</he>, <cite ref="Q01746"><he>פִּירְ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 5:5">Tosef. Kil. V, 5</cite> <he>כל הפ׳ כולן וכ׳</he> all mules (whether the sire be a horse or an ass) are considered one genus (may be harnessed together); <cite ref="Chullin 79a:10">Ḥull. 79ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64">Gen. R. s. 64</cite>; a. e.
